title: World Feature Rule Definition
description: Defines a feature rule with conditions, description, and distribution parameters.

description.title: Description
description.description:
Identifier for the Feature Rule and Feature to place.

Properties:
• identifier (string)
• places_feature (string)

defaultSnippets.label: World Feature Rule Description
defaultSnippets.description: Defines the identifier and feature reference for a feature rule.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description:
Parameters to control where and when the feature will be placed.

Properties:
• minecraft:biome_filter ({ domain, operator, subject, ... })
• placement_pass (string)

defaultSnippets.label: World Feature Rule Conditions
defaultSnippets.description: Defines conditions for feature placement including biome filters and placement pass.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description:
Parameters controlling the initial scatter of the feature.

Properties:
• coordinate_eval_order (string) = xzy
• iterations
• scatter_chance
• x
• y
• z

defaultSnippets.label: World Components Scatter Params
defaultSnippets.description: Controls the scatter distribution of a particular object.

world_feature_rule_description.title: World Feature Rule Description
world_feature_rule_description.description: Defines the identifier and feature reference for a feature rule.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The name of this feature rule in the format 'namespace_name:rule_name'. 'rule_name' must match the filename.

places_feature.title: Places Feature
places_feature.description: Named reference to the feature controlled by this rule.

world_feature_rule_conditions.title: World Feature Rule Conditions
world_feature_rule_conditions.description: Defines conditions for feature placement including biome filters and placement pass.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

minecraft:biome_filter.description:
List of filter tests to determine which biomes this rule will attach to.

Properties:
• domain (object)
• operator (object)
• subject (object)
• test (string)
• value (object)

placement_pass.title: Placement Pass
placement_pass.description: When the feature should be placed relative to others. Earlier passes in the list are guaranteed to occur before later passes. Order is not guaranteed within each pass.

world_components_scatter_params.title: World Components Scatter Params
world_components_scatter_params.description: Controls the scatter distribution of a particular object.

coordinate_eval_order.title: Coordinate Evaluation Order
coordinate_eval_order.description: The order in which coordinates will be evaluated. Should be used when a coordinate depends on another. If omitted, defaults to "xzy". Supported orders are defined by "Coordinate Evaluation Order".

iterations.title: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of scattered positions to generate.

defaultSnippets.label: Scatter Chance (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Scatter Chance as an object

scatter_chance.title: Scatter Chance
scatter_chance.description: Probability that this scatter will occur. Not evaluated each iteration; either no iterations will run, or all will.

defaultSnippets.label: Scatter Chance (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Scatter Chance as an object

distribution.title: Random Distribution Type
distribution.description: Type of distribution. Supported distributions are defined by "Random Distribution Type".

extent.title: Extent
extent.description: Lower and upper bound (inclusive) of the scatter range, as an offset from the input point to scatter around.

grid_offset.title: Grid Offset
grid_offset.description: When the distribution type is grid, defines the offset along this axis.

step_size.title: Step Size
step_size.description: When the distribution type is grid, defines the distance between steps along this axis.

x.description: Distribution for the coordinate (evaluated each iteration).
